aicommit2 v2.9.0

A Reactive CLI that generates commit messages for Git and Jujutsu with various AI

Usage:
  aicommit2 [flags...]
  aicommit2 <command>

Commands:
  config              Manage configuration settings
  doctor              Check health status of configured AI providers
  github-login        Login to GitHub and setup access to GitHub Models
  hook                Install or uninstall the Git prepare-commit-msg hook
  log                 Manage log files generated by the application
  rewrite             Rewrite the commit message of a commit using AI (defaults to HEAD)
  setup               Interactive setup wizard for configuring AI providers, or set up integrations
  stats               View AI request statistics and performance metrics

Flags - Message Options:
    -g, --generate <number>        Number of messages to generate (Warning: generating multiple costs more) (default: 1)
    -i, --include-body             Force include commit body in all generated messages
    -l, --locale <string>          Locale to use for the generated commit messages (default: en)
    -p, --prompt <string>          Custom prompt to let users fine-tune provided prompt
    -t, --type <string>            Type of commit message to generate (default: conventional)

  Behavior:
    -a, --all                    Automatically stage changes in tracked files for the commit
    -s, --auto-select            Automatically select the message when only one is generated
    -c, --clipboard              Copy the selected message to the clipboard
    -y, --confirm                Skip confirmation when committing after message generation (default: false)
    -d, --dry-run                Generate commit message without committing (output only)
    -e, --edit                   Open the AI-generated commit message in your default editor
    -o, --output <string>        Output format for non-interactive mode (json). For LazyGit integration

  VCS Selection:
        --git                Force use Git (overrides auto-detection)
        --jj                 Force use Jujutsu (overrides auto-detection)
        --jj-auto-new        Run jj new after jj describe (default: false, only describe)
        --yadm               Force use YADM (overrides auto-detection)

  Hook Integration:
        --hook-mode           Run in git hook mode, allowing chaining with other hooks
        --pre-commit          Run in pre-commit Framework, allowing chaining with other hooks
        --watch-commit        

  Formatting:
        --disable-lowercase        Disable automatic lowercase conversion of commit messages
    -x, --exclude <string>         Files to exclude from AI analysis

  Debug:
    -v, --verbose        Enable verbose logging for this run

  Other:
    -h, --help           Show help
        --version        Show version
